title: Higginbotham and Hawkins family origins; Irene's father
summary: The father's side came from Massachusetts, and Irene's father Donnie was a brother.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Q : What did they say about ... do you recollect anything they said about their history when they came over, when they came over? Was it always in Georgia?

? : Well, my brother, Donnie, he knew more about it and I know we used to sit down when I was living, well, you were living there, too. I was visiting my brother and their family after I got married. And on my father's side, the people came from Massachusetts because some of them, when they came, I guess they came you know they were slaves ... the grandparents and when they came to Massachusetts, some of them took the name of Higginbotham and the others took the name of Hawkins. Because the Hawkins I remember. I don't know if I can remember but the Hawkins came from ... when we were living in Atlanta ... my brother's daughter, Irene, that lives here in New York, she was born in Atlanta at the Hawkins farm.
Oh, Irene's father is Donnie. He taught school here
You met Irene, didn't you? Wrote Good Morning, Irene.

She was born and my uncle had passed but first cousin [.. (too much noise)] there must have been about seven children, three girls and four boys because we still have an uncle living in Northwest Virginia, Lucius Higginbotham.
Is that what your father named a son after him? Lucius, right?
